focusSequence.name: Open NodeRoom's Trace tab from the artifact shellpassStart from the real artifact panel. NodeRoom exposes a trace tab and a bottom room trace strip, so users can move from live room activity into the full provenance view

Use the real NodeRoom trace tabspassThe sample should follow NodeRoom's detail-tab model instead of a loose walkthrough card: Overview, Steps, Flow, Evidence, and Raw JSON all hang off one selected trace record.Trace tab

Seed the app from NodeRoom TraceRecord datapassNodeTrace now seeds from the same mental model NodeRoom uses: records contain ordered steps, source metadata, verdicts, attachments, and raw audit payloads.Data model - Step

Render code and UI evidence like NodeRoom step rowspassEach step is an ordered, source-linked unit. Screenshot attachments carry a normalized box so the UI can draw exactly what was clicked or extracted.Steps - Step 04 -

Keep the latest flow tab behaviorpassNodeRoom's Flow tab derives graph nodes and edges from the same ordered steps. Clicking a node opens the same step renderer, avoiding drift between graph and list.Flow - Step 05 - src

Match NodeRoom's dark trace surfacepassThe sample app should look like NodeRoom: dark app chrome, compact tabs, muted metadata, accent verdict pills, step cards, and screenshot highlight boxes.Look and feel - Step 06 - s
